title: Doctoral Researcher, AI & Robotics
org: ICIQ (Lloret-Fillol group) · Universitat Rovira i Virgili
note: Thesis: AI-driven robotics for catalyst development (Spanish national grant 2AID, RAISE subgroup). Designing an AI-driven autonomous flow photoreactor and a self-driving lab that combines robotics, high-throughput experimentation, agentic AI and closed-loop control. Doctoral School of Nanosystems, Bioengineering and Energy; ICIQ fully funded PhD programme 2025.

title: Research Software Engineer
note: Designed the software, protocols and electronics for a 1.2 kW parallel photoreactor: 4-layer STM32F4/ESP32 motherboard and analog control card, Raspberry Pi controllers and touchscreen UIs for operation and intensity control.

title: Electrical Engineering Intern
note: Modelled the electrochemical cell equations of an aluminium–air battery in MATLAB/Simulink (simulating up to 2 kW), with state-of-charge, current estimation and thermal models.

title: Electronic Design Engineer Intern
note: Integrated LTE-M and ADS131M08 data acquisition (4 kSPS) on an ARM Cortex-M0, with firmware, PCB and FreeRTOS for acquisition and cloud configuration, 30% more efficient than before.

title: M.Sc. Integration, Security & Trust in Embedded Systems
note: Embedded security, side-channel and fault attacks. Project: QuadControl, experimental validation of a controller for multiple drones with Qualisys Track Manager. Grenoble INP Foundation International Excellence Scholarship.

title: Automation Support Engineer
note: Demonstrated Cognex machine-vision systems on industrial visits, operated a Universal Robots UR10, and contributed to machine-vision R&D and project proposals.

title: R&D Engineer
note: Led the design and production of a disinfection chamber, vegetable washing machine, IoT touch switchboard, water pump controller and a humanoid security guard robot.

title: General Secretary, PUC Robotics Club
note: Gave robotics talks and workshops in schools and colleges, mentored at the IUB Line Follower Contest 2018 and CU Science Carnival 2019, and organised the Robo-Cricket League 2018. IEEE student member (2018–19).

title: Founder, Ahsan's Lab
note: A student research group for robotics, IoT and agri-tech. Now archived; its alumni continue in research and industry worldwide.

title: B.Sc. Electrical & Electronic Engineering
note: Thesis: Design and Implementation of a Drain Cleaner Robotic Vehicle.
